name: tavo-ui-monorepo
description: Public monorepo for the Tavo.js UI web packages.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @tavojs/ui-core && npm run build --workspace @tavojs/ui-cli && npm run build --workspace @tavojs/ui
scripts.pack:dry: npm pack --dry-run --workspace @tavojs/ui-core && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @tavojs/ui-cli && npm run pack:dry --workspace @tavojs/ui
scripts.test: npm run check:framework-contract && npm test --workspace @tavojs/ui-core && npm test --workspace @tavojs/ui-cli && npm test --workspace @tavojs/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @tavojs/ui-core && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.release:check: npm run release:manifest && npm run release:audit && npm run check:framework-contract && npm test --workspace @tavojs/ui-core && npm test --workspace @tavojs/ui-cli && npm run release:check --workspace @tavojs/ui && npm run release:pack
scripts.release:pack: npm pack --dry-run --workspace @tavojs/ui-core && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @tavojs/ui-cli && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @tavojs/ui
